title: Exercise 1: Install Two Tools and Compare
description: Four commands create a directory, install Claude Code, install a second tool (example shows Gemini CLI), and start a Claude Code session in the fresh directory.

steps.description: The starter hint runs mkdir, installs Claude Code via npm, installs a second tool (Gemini CLI as example), then launches claude with /login if prompted.
Line 1 creates an isolated exercise directory so each tool runs in a clean workspace.

steps.question: What is the success criterion for this exercise?
steps.answer: two transcript files saved, each showing the full exchange to a working Python script, and a comparison paragraph naming at least one specific difference in permission gates or file reads
